lines.en: Ssssh, follow me!
Brrrr, closing in...
Flicker, silent as night.
Wraiths dance, hunt prey.
Sun too bright, I'll protect.
Rip flesh, gain strength.
In moonlight, I’m strong.
Master calls, I lead the way.
Avoid light, hide in shadows.
Blood magic, night’s magic.
My shadow hugs the wall.
My paws land without a sound.
Wait in shadows, prey ahead.
Whisper of wind, I heed.
Moonlight, I wait.
Yamata no Orochi, my foe.

lines.zh: 影子里，我闻到了鬼杀队。
lines.en: In the shadows I smell the Demon Slayer Corps.
Night falls, I strike.
Sunlight, I follow.
Moonlight, I trick.
Patience, prey arrives.
Moon veils, I escape.
Prey near, prey near.
You move, beware.
Feel it? Prey comes.
I am already standing on your shadow.
I see you, prey here.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，等你先伸手。
lines.en: I lower my body, waiting for you to reach out first.
Prey around you.
Your move, I see.

lines.zh: 我在等主人，不咬他的人。
lines.en: I wait for my master; I bite no one he claims.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动，都在我监控中！
lines.en: Every move, I watch.
My nose twitches, learning your scent.
I crouch low, tail rigid.

lines.zh: 影子在你脚边多出一道
lines.en: A second shadow joins yours.
I tilt my head at what you hold.

lines.zh: 哀嚎一声，影狼的身影愈发模糊。
lines.en: A sad howl, and the shadow wolf fades.
A patch of fur cut away. I growl.
The wolf's fur begins to fade.
The shadow wolf whimpers in pain.
The injured shadow wolf collapses.
The shadow wolf fades further.
The shadow wolf howls in agony.
The injured shadow wolf struggles.
The shadow wolf howls weakly.
The shadow wolf fades more.

lines.zh: 你手中的肉块为何不对我施展魔咒？
lines.en: Why aren't you under my blood curse with that meat?

lines.zh: 你的食物为何不能引诱我？
lines.en: Your food should be enticing me, not repelling me.

lines.zh: 你那点微弱的光芒对我无用！
lines.en: Your feeble light means nothing to me!

lines.zh: 你的肉块为何未能勾起我的欲望？
lines.en: Your meat isn't tempting me, fool!

lines.zh: 你为何不使用更强的魔法？
lines.en: Why don't you use a stronger curse?

lines.zh: 我的影狼本能被你唤醒了！
lines.en: My shadow instincts are aroused!

lines.zh: 我的魂灵在你的肉块中颤抖！
lines.en: My soul shivers at the sight of your meat!

lines.zh: 你的肉块对我毫无吸引力！
lines.en: Your meat means nothing to me!

lines.zh: 我要享用你的生命能量！
lines.en: I will feed on your life force!

lines.zh: 为何你的光芒让我感到恐惧？
lines.en: Why does your light frighten me?
Your strength can't harm me!
My fur is unbreakable!

lines.zh: 影子里躲一躲，就过去了。
lines.en: A step into shadow and it passes.

lines.zh: 我的力量远超你的想象！
lines.en: My strength exceeds your imagination!
You can't stop my attack!

lines.zh: 我的爪牙是你力量的影子！
lines.en: My claws are but shadows of your might!

lines.zh: 你的攻击太弱，无法伤我分毫！
lines.en: Your attacks are too weak to harm me!

lines.zh: 我不会被你的力量所伤！
lines.en: I won't be harmed by your power!

lines.zh: 你的力量在我面前如纸般脆弱！
lines.en: Your strength is as fragile as paper against me!
My power crushes all!

lines.zh: 影子里没有回声，我独自绕圈。
lines.en: No answer comes from the shadows; I circle alone.

lines.zh: 影子里没有同类，只有我的主人。
lines.en: No kin in the shadows, only my master.
I need a partner!
Where is my shadow mate?
My kind is near!
Find my shadow mate!
My kind is in the darkness!

lines.zh: 我的影子伴侣在暗处等待！
lines.en: My shadow mate waits in the shadows!
I seek my soulmate!
My kind is in the shadows!

lines.zh: 鼻子动了动，嗅到一点味道。
lines.en: Nose twitches, I catch a scent.

lines.zh: 凝视你片刻，然后转身消失
lines.en: stares at you for a moment then vanishes

lines.zh: 在你脚下徘徊，似乎在等待命令
lines.en: wavers near your feet, as if awaiting a command

lines.zh: 舔舐着地面，似乎在寻找食物
lines.en: licks the ground, as if searching for food

lines.zh: 目光闪烁，露出尖锐的牙齿
lines.en: glows, revealing sharp teeth

lines.zh: 跳到你肩膀上，发出细微的呼吸声
lines.en: jumps onto your shoulder, making a faint breathing sound
stares at the sun, seeming indecisive

lines.zh: 在月光下发出淡绿色的光芒
lines.en: glows a pale green in the moonlight

lines.zh: 从阴影中缓缓走出，发出沉重的呼吸声
lines.en: emerges from the shadows, making a heavy breathing sound

lines.zh: 轻舔你的手臂，表示亲近
lines.en: gently licks your arm, showing affection

lines.zh: 盯着鬼杀队成员的眼睛
lines.en: stares into the Shinobi squad member's eyes
growls, readying to attack

lines.zh: 突然跃向目标，快速而不失优雅
lines.en: leaps at the target, swift and graceful
howls, summoning the Blood Curse

lines.zh: 跟随目标，保持一定距离
lines.en: follows the target, maintaining a distance

lines.zh: 发出阴森的笑声，靠近鬼杀队成员
lines.en: makes a chilling laugh, approaching the Shinobi squad member

lines.zh: 迅速接近，不给鬼杀队成员反应机会
lines.en: approaches quickly, leaving no time for the Shinobi squad member to react

lines.zh: 低声咆哮，释放暗影力量
lines.en: low growls, releasing shadow power

lines.zh: 在目标周围游荡，寻找最佳攻击位置
lines.en: wanders around the target, seeking the best attack position

lines.zh: 露出獠牙，发出低沉的咆哮
lines.en: exposes fangs, issuing a low growl
The wind brings the smell of Demon Slayers.
Blood Demon Art forms between my paws.
I go for his scabbard first.
Master, someone is ahead.
One growl and it begins.

lines.zh: 盯着鬼杀队成员，准备攻击
lines.en: stares at the Shinobi squad member, ready to attack

lines.zh: 靠近鬼杀队成员，准备撕咬
lines.en: approaches the Shinobi squad member, ready to bite

lines.zh: 从远处发出嘶嘶声，吸引鬼杀队成员注意
lines.en: makes a faint hiss, drawing the Shinobi squad member's attention

lines.zh: 紧随鬼杀队成员，准备突袭
lines.en: follows the Shinobi squad member, ready for an ambush

lines.zh: 轻巧地跳跃，靠近鬼杀队成员
lines.en: jumps lightly, approaching the Shinobi squad member

lines.zh: 发出低沉的吼声，锁定目标
lines.en: growls lowly, locking onto the target

lines.zh: 从阴影中出现，悄无声息地接近鬼杀队成员
lines.en: emerges from the shadows, silently approaching the Shinobi squad member

lines.zh: 在鬼杀队成员周围游荡，寻找弱点
lines.en: wanders around the Shinobi squad member, searching for weaknesses

lines.zh: 发出细微的声音，引诱鬼杀队成员接近
lines.en: makes a faint sound, enticing the Shinobi squad member closer

lines.zh: 在鬼杀队成员背后潜行，准备偷袭
lines.en: creeps behind the Shinobi squad member, ready to strike
I move to his downwind side.
Claws reach out of my shadow.
I wait for his back to turn.
I fade into a smear of black.

lines.zh: 牙齿已经贴着他的脚跟
lines.en: My teeth are at his heel.
Moonlight stretches my shadow.
Legs first, then the throat.
I count his remaining steps.
My art coils around his feet.
Silently I close the ring.
Howl and leap at the target!
Shadow wolf bites, painful scream!
Darkness comes, claws slash!
Tear flesh, wounds bleed!
Attack in a frenzy!
Grim fires surround, bite unceasingly!
More fierce under night!
Rampage in close combat, no breathing space!
Darkness consumes all, attack!
Lurk in silence, sudden assault!
My fangs tear his calf.
My shadow bites his.
My paw knocks his blade away.
I burst from the corner and bite his wrist.
My art bursts beneath his feet.
I drag him into the shade.
I crunch through his bracer.
Howling, I bowl him over.
Spawn in darkness!
Be alert, Demon Slayer!
Night falls, Shadow Wolf appears!
Appears in dark corners!

lines.zh: 月光拉长一道影子，我站起来。
lines.en: Moonlight stretches a shadow, and I rise out of it.
Follows Demon Slayers!
Beware, Demon Slayers!
Awaits in the dark!
Watch your surroundings, Demon Slayers!
Night’s hidden threat!
A pair of green eyes joins the shade.
A wolf shape condenses in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它从主人的影子里走出
lines.en: It steps out of its master's shadow.
The first howl rises in the night.
The flames burn the shadow wolf.

lines.zh: 这团黑影摔一下也会散。
lines.en: Even this shadow scatters when it falls.
Struggles in water and is injured.
Shrapnel from the explosion injures the shadow wolf.
Hit by an arrow and is injured.
Magic damage injures the shadow wolf.
Starvation weakens the shadow wolf.
Lightning strikes the shadow wolf and injures it.
Falls into the void and faints.
